_comment: Reference Solstone workloads used to translate raw tok/s benchmarks into practical task-time estimates. Token counts are hand-curated conservative estimates (not sampled from live traffic) and should be treated as first-order heuristics, not guarantees. Revise when measurements disagree with reality. A 'vision' task's prompt cost includes an implicit fixed-image-encoder cost captured in the model's measured prompt_tok_s (see harness.py vision mode).
